executiveSummary: The website presents a credible local business with clear contact paths, but mobile performance and homepage messaging can be strengthened.

strengths.title: Clear contact information
strengths.evidence: The crawl found a dedicated contact page and visible phone number on the homepage.

issues.title: Mobile performance is below a comfortable threshold
issues.recommendation: Optimize hero imagery and defer non-critical scripts on the homepage.

heroSuggestions.headline: Trusted local service, done right
heroSuggestions.supportingCopy: Help visitors understand your offer and next step within the first screen.
heroSuggestions.designDirection: Use a clean hero with one primary action and a supporting trust line.

outreachEmail.subject: A few practical ideas for your website
outreachEmail.body:
Hi there,
